english_outline.section1: Main conclusion: Seagate's FY2027 Q1 (quarter ended Oct 2, 2026) beat consensus on EPS and revenue, but the stock remains far below its 52-week high and the beat magnitude has narrowed. Source: Investing.com.
english_outline.section2: Core business change: HAMR volume crossover expected by December 2026; hyperscaler purchase orders cover next 4-5 quarters; incremental gross margins exceed 70%; 50TB drives planned for calendar 2027. Source: CFO at Goldman Sachs conference, via Investing.com.
english_outline.section3: Expectations for growth, profit, cash flow: Revenue rose ~60% YoY to $4.20B; gross margin expanded to 52.3% in prior quarter; FY2026 free cash flow hit record $3.1B; debt reduction nearly complete; buybacks expected to rise in calendar 2027. Sources: Investing.com, company filings.
english_outline.section4: Market pricing: Stock fell 25.65% over past month; pre-market weaker but intraday reversal; analysts' price targets ($1,000-$1,400 from TD Cowen, Rosenblatt, Bernstein, Morgan Stanley) predate pullback; fair value model shows only -1.4% upside. Source: Investing.com.
english_outline.section5: Next quarter validation: December HAMR crossover; 40TB drive qualifications; 50TB ramp in calendar 2027; capital returns acceleration; FY27 Q2 report on Jan 27, 2027 with consensus EPS $8.59 and revenue $4.52B. Source: Investing.com.

reader_questions: SEC官方文件显示该季度营收为42.33亿美元，而市场报道口径为42.0亿美元，两者差异是否意味着稿件中的营收数据存在口径混用？
稿件称毛利率从35.6%升至52.3%，但52.3%对应的是截至2026年7月3日的季度，而非本季度，这一时间错配是否会影响对利润率趋势的判断？
稿件将HAMR销量交叉点、超大规模客户订单覆盖四到五个季度、增量毛利率超70%等表述归于CFO，但这些内容均来自市场报道转述，是否应明确标注为媒体报道而非公司官方披露？
checks: 核对SEC官方文件：营收42.33亿美元、营业利润20.64亿美元、净利润17.61亿美元、经营现金流16.90亿美元均为官方口径；市场报道的42.0亿美元为共识对比口径，两者不可混用，修订稿应分别标注来源。
核对市场报道：52.3%毛利率对应截至2026年7月3日的季度，35.6%对应2025年3月，本季度毛利率未被获取，修订稿应保留这一时间限定，不得暗示本季度毛利率即为52.3%。
核对市场报道：HAMR交叉点、订单覆盖、增量毛利率、50TB计划、债务与回购均出自Investing.com对高盛会议及此前管理层表态的转述，修订稿应统一标注为媒体报道口径，避免写成公司官方确认。
